text: No, no deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. The latest forest-cover loss event was 67.7 hectares in 2020 (just before the baseline). While there was a 0.4-hectare loss in 2021, it was below the 0.5-hectare minimum threshold for counting as an event. The JRC 2020 data also confirms no forest cover remained by the baseline date. No further losses met the criteria after 2020.
